role: Settings > Biometrics page core: state, bounds-clamping bindings for VO2max/HR/LTHR/FTP/body weight, lower-bound cleanup on defocus/disappear, the 'Fill from Apple Health' action, and the HR-zones mode label/footer. The Form content lives in BiometricsSettingsPage+Sections.swift.
types: BiometricsSettingsPage: struct (View) — biometrics settings page; reads/writes SettingsManager.settings
state: @FocusState isNumericFieldFocused (one Bool shared by every numeric TextField)
toplevel: Static range constants (67-73) are read by BiometricsSettingsPage+Sections.swift when building the clamped bindings. No #if blocks.

flags.text: Every keystroke in a numeric field assigns SettingsManager.settings, which posts flowRecoverySettingsChanged per keystroke and makes intermediate values (e.g. 1 and 18 while typing 180) the live settings that AssistantContextSource and other observers see; disk writes are coalesced so only the final value is normally persisted.

units.does: Builds a Binding<UserSettings> whose get returns settingsManager.settings and set assigns it (stand-in for $settingsManager.settings since @Environment has no projected binding); used for the useHealthKitVO2Max toggle (BiometricsSettingsPage+Sections.swift:112).

flags.text: The same get/set Binding<UserSettings> over SettingsManager.settings is re-declared as a private settingsBinding in at least six other views instead of one shared helper.

units.does: Page body: ZStack of the keyboard-dismiss overlay and biometricsForm, titled 'Biometrics'; when numeric focus is lost and when the page disappears it runs dropValuesBelowMinimum to clear below-minimum entries.

branches.cond: focus changed to false (user left the numeric fields)
branches.effect: dropValuesBelowMinimum() runs; when focus becomes true nothing happens. Moving focus directly from one numeric field to another keeps the shared Bool true so no cleanup runs until all fields are left or the page closes.

units.does: When a numeric field is focused, overlays a clear full-size tap target (zIndex 1) that sets isNumericFieldFocused = false on tap to dismiss the number pad; otherwise renders nothing.

branches.effect: true: clear tappable overlay above the form (taps anywhere dismiss focus and are swallowed by the overlay); false: empty view

units.does: Copies settings, clears (sets nil) VO2max override < 10, maxHR < 80, resting HR < 30, LTHR < 80, cycling/running FTP < 50 W, body weight < 30 kg, and writes the copy back only if anything changed.

branches.effect: kept; below 10 → nil (formula default applies)
kept; below 30 → nil (a Health fill never stores one below 30, fillBodyWeight skips it)
early return with no write; otherwise assigns settingsManager.settings (save + notification)

units.does: Returns value if it is >= minimum, else nil (nil stays nil).

branches.effect: returns value; otherwise nil

units.does: Returns a Binding<Int?> onto a UserSettings key path: get reads the stored value; set stores nil for nil, otherwise min(value, range.upperBound) (upper bound only, lower bound deferred to dropValuesBelowMinimum).

branches.effect: stores nil and returns; otherwise stores min(v, upperBound)

units.does: Double variant of clampedIntBinding: set stores nil for nil, else min(value, range.upperBound); used for the VO2max override.

branches.effect: stores nil and returns; otherwise stores min(v, upperBound)

units.does: Async: sets isFillingFromHealthKit, fetches the HealthKit biometric profile (body mass, biological sex, date of birth), fills only empty settings fields via fill(_:from:), saves settings if anything was filled, and sets fillFeedback to 'Nothing to fill…' or 'Filled: <labels>.'.
units.entry: Button action in BiometricsSettingsPage+Sections.swift:67 (Task { await fillFromAppleHealth() })

branches.cond: at least one field was filled
branches.effect: writes settings back (save + notification); otherwise no write
fillFeedback = 'Nothing to fill — Apple Health had nothing new.' (also shown when HealthKit read was denied/failed, since denials come back nil); otherwise 'Filled: a, b.'

units.does: Static: runs fillBodyWeight, fillBiologicalSex and fillBirthday on the inout settings and returns the non-nil labels of the fields it filled.
units.entry: Also called directly by tests EmuquTests/HealthSourcedSyncMarkerTests.swift:19,34,45 and CloudSessionPayloadHealthReadingsTests.swift:206

units.does: If profile has a body weight within minimumBodyWeightKg…maximumBodyWeightKg (30–250 kg) and settings has none, sets bodyWeightKg, marks .bodyWeight as Health-sourced (so iCloud backup excludes it), and returns a label 'weight (N lb|kg)' using the units preference; otherwise nil (nothing filled, nothing reported).
reads: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (standard suite, legacy fallback when the App Group key is missing)
writes: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite; one-time copy of the legacy standard value via UnitsPreferenceStore.current getter, UnitsPreference.swift:136-139)

branches.cond: profile weight present, settings weight nil, and weight within 30–250 kg
branches.effect: fills and marks; otherwise returns nil (existing manual value kept, out-of-range Health weight not filled)
label in pounds (kg*2.20462 rounded); otherwise kg rounded

units.does: If settings has no biological sex and the profile maps to an app sex, sets it, marks .biologicalSex as Health-sourced, and returns a localized 'biological sex (female|male|other)' label; otherwise nil.

branches.cond: settings sex nil AND profile.appBiologicalSex non-nil
branches.effect: fills; otherwise nil (HK notSet/denied maps to nil)
returns 'biological sex (female)'
returns 'biological sex (male)'
returns 'biological sex (other)'

units.does: If settings has no birthday and the profile has a date of birth, sets birthday, marks .birthday as Health-sourced, and returns 'birthday (<medium date in app locale>)'; otherwise nil.

branches.cond: settings birthday nil AND profile DOB present
branches.effect: fills; otherwise nil

units.does: Returns 'Manual' when any of maxHR, userRestingHR or lactateThresholdHR is overridden, else 'Auto'.

branches.effect: 'Manual'; otherwise 'Auto'

units.does: Returns 'Effective: max X bpm · resting Y bpm · LTHR Z bpm' from UserSettings.effectiveMaxHR/effectiveRestingHR/effectiveLTHR.
Binding<Double?> for the body-weight field: get shows kg or kg*2.20462 lb; set converts lb→kg when imperial, stores nil for nil, else min(kg, maximumBodyWeightKg = 250).

branches.effect: returns converted value; nil → field empty
get returns pounds; otherwise kg
stores nil and returns
set converts v/2.20462 to kg; otherwise v used as kg
